sourceCensus.closure: Every entry is classified and owner-mapped; source-only entries are not required to occur in .riv bytes.

binaryEvidence.eligibility: CoreRegistry-instantiable object/asset keys and generated deserialize property cases only.

behavioralEvidence.closure: Feature-family workloads and differential/security traces cover script behavior; module/symbol names remain source attribution.

productCases.workflow: import, inspect diagnostics, reimport, save, reopen, export, and exact-HYA preview a responsive interactive component
bind health, inventory list, localization, focus, keyboard/gamepad, sound, and reduced motion without a Rive runtime in the shipped page
play a high-detail vector/mesh/constraint loader under resize and device loss with deterministic first frame
run Luau protocols and validated custom WGSL with hard CPU, memory, output, binding, and GPU budgets

sourceIdentityModes.rive-cloud: Rive Cloud file revision id plus exported bytes SHA-256; mutable share links and Editor versions are insufficient.
sourceIdentityModes.official-git: Official rive-app repository plus 40-character commit, repository path, immutable source/download URLs, byte length, bytes SHA-256 and repository license evidence. Inputs are fetched into ephemeral storage and are never vendored in HaiYue repositories.

acquisitionGate: G11 may add formalAssets only when every metadata field and applicable content right is present. One immutable official asset may carry multiple independently named evidence roles when its attributed feature families and pinned workload actions satisfy each role; roles never reduce the trace/device matrix. Official rive-app Git inputs may rely on immutable commit/path/hash/license attribution and do not require a Rive Cloud revision. A source link proves input identity, not parity: every formal result still requires frozen oracle/HYA traces, device metadata and artifact validation. Empty formalAssets is not release evidence.
